dct_description_sm: A layer of the Waterfront Areas along the shorelines of Lake Ontario, Lake Scugog and Lake Simcoe which include sensitive environmental features and shoreline areas, as well as areas meant to provide residents and visitors with access to enjoy the recreational opportunities the waterfronts provide, including the Lake Ontario portion of the Great Lakes Waterfront Trail. ROP Consolidation September 3, 2024.
